### Invariant-Matrix Repair Summary (Findings F1–F5)

All 5 defects identified during the independent Muse review have been addressed in a single coordinated batch in [`tools/csg/factory-mcp/src/shared-context-transport.mjs`](file:///C:/Users/x/Documents/ChatGPT/治理控制-自動軟體工廠/VNEXT5.2-MCP-READSYNC-AG-WORK-20261004/tools/csg/factory-mcp/src/shared-context-transport.mjs) and verified via [`tools/csg/factory-mcp/tests/shared-context-transport.test.mjs`](file:///C:/Users/x/Documents/ChatGPT/治理控制-自動軟體工廠/VNEXT5.2-MCP-READSYNC-AG-WORK-20261004/tools/csg/factory-mcp/tests/shared-context-transport.test.mjs).

---

#### 1. Defect Fixes

- **F1 (Strict Lower-40hex Validation)**:
  - In [`parseApprovedRoute`](file:///C:/Users/x/Documents/ChatGPT/治理控制-自動軟體工廠/VNEXT5.2-MCP-READSYNC-AG-WORK-20261004/tools/csg/factory-mcp/src/shared-context-transport.mjs#L68) and [`nativeGitGet`](file:///C:/Users/x/Documents/ChatGPT/治理控制-自動軟體工廠/VNEXT5.2-MCP-READSYNC-AG-WORK-20261004/tools/csg/factory-mcp/src/shared-context-transport.mjs#L236), removed all `.toLowerCase()` and loose trimming on OIDs. Input refs and git response hashes now pass directly to `oid(sha)`, strictly enforcing `/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/` and rejecting uppercase or malformed hex with `MALFORMED_OID`.
- **F2 (Bounded Diagnostic Error Streaming & Secret Isolation)**:
  - In [`httpGet`](file:///C:/Users/x/Documents/ChatGPT/治理控制-自動軟體工廠/VNEXT5.2-MCP-READSYNC-AG-WORK-20261004/tools/csg/factory-mcp/src/shared-context-transport.mjs#L143), implemented `extractBoundedDiagnostics` to stream at most 4KB of diagnostics (with a 1MB overall threshold) to classify 403 vs. 429/rate-limit. The error body is discarded immediately; the resulting error object never stores or leaks the error payload or embedded secrets.
- **F3 (Raw Buffer Fidelity & Strict Delimiter Separation)**:
  - Configured `execFile` with `encoding: null` so stdout is returned as a native `Buffer`. File contents from `git cat-file -p` are base64-encoded directly from raw bytes, preserving exact multi-byte UTF-8 sequences, trailing newlines, and binary bytes without string-decoding roundtripping.
  - In `ls-remote` parsing, replaced whitespace splitting with strict tab delimiter parsing (`line.indexOf('\t')`) to separate the SHA and branch name.
- **F4 (Cache Directory Containment)**:
  - Implemented [`validateGitCacheDir`](file:///C:/Users/x/Documents/ChatGPT/治理控制-自動軟體工廠/VNEXT5.2-MCP-READSYNC-AG-WORK-20261004/tools/csg/factory-mcp/src/shared-context-transport.mjs#L27) which verifies that `options.gitCacheDir` is absolute, contains no traversal components (`..`), and is strictly contained within `os.tmpdir()`, preventing arbitrary directory access.
- **F5 (Injected Executor Coverage for Real `cat-file` Path)**:
  - Updated tests to execute the actual `cat-file` exec path via `gitExec` rather than bypassing it. Injected executor tests verify constructor options, raw `Buffer` preservation, `maxBuffer` truncation (`READ_BOUND_EXCEEDED`), `ENOENT` handling (`GIT_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE`), deadline abortion (`SHARED_READ_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`), oversized route rejection (>2048 chars), and uppercase OID rejection without live network or external processes.
